headline: PAN AMERICAN SILVER DOUBLES REALIZED PRICE TO $70.97/oz — Record $300M Q2 Returns, $344M Free Cash Flow as Buyback Pace Surges 9x
source_name: Business Wire / Pan American Silver Corp. (TSX/Nasdaq: PAAS)
snippet: Pan American Silver (TSX/Nasdaq: PAAS) reported Q2 2026 results showing a realized silver price of $70.97 per ounce — more than double the year-ago figure — driving $344 million in attributable free cash flow and $1.1 billion in revenue on production of 6.5 million silver ounces and 166,000 gold ounces. Record total shareholder returns of $300 million were deployed in the quarter: $224 million in share repurchases (approximately 4.4 million shares at $51.46 avg) and $76 million in dividends. The buyback pace accelerated nearly ninefold from Q1's $25 million, and year-to-date the company has repurchased 7.3 million shares for $358 million — a capital return program that, when combined with the commodity price environment, makes PAAS one of the clearest direct-play vehicles on the structural silver bull market for investors who want producer exposure without junior-stage exploration risk.

headline: OREZONE SETS PRODUCTION RECORD: 58,566 oz GOLD Q2 — First Full Quarter With Casa Berardi Transforms Mid-Tier Into Dual-Asset Producer
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Orezone Gold Corporation (TSX: ORE; ASX: ORE)
snippet: Orezone Gold Corporation (TSX/ASX: ORE) reported August 12 its highest-ever quarterly gold production at 58,566 ounces — the first full quarter as a dual-mine producer following the acquisition of Casa Berardi, which contributed 20,503 ounces from 364,000 ore tonnes processed at 2.01 g/t head grade. Sales totalled 60,654 ounces at an average realized price of $4,401 per ounce. All-in sustaining costs were $2,449 per gold ounce sold — among the highest in the mid-tier peer group, but still generating roughly $1,950/oz in gross margin at current prices. For investors in TSX/ASX-listed dual-listed gold equities: Orezone's Casa Berardi integration marks the transition from single-asset Burkina Faso gold producer to a diversified mid-tier with Québec underground operations, restructuring both the risk profile and the investor base of the company simultaneously.

headline: GOGOLD'S $284M CASH PILE EXCEEDS LOS RICOS SOUTH BUILD COST — Silver Producer Posts Record Q3 Operating Cash Flow; Construction Decision Made
source_name: Junior Mining Network / GoGold Resources Inc. (TSX: GGD)
snippet: GoGold Resources (TSX: GGD) reported fiscal Q3 2026 results (quarter ending June 30) showing record operating cash flow of $26.3 million on $27.8 million in revenue from 419,986 silver equivalent ounces sold, with total production of 477,464 AgEq ounces — a 21% sequential increase — including Parral tailings silver production at a five-year high. The most strategically significant data point: GoGold holds $284 million USD in cash, which exceeds the $227 million initial capital expenditure outlined in the feasibility study for Los Ricos South, the permitted, construction-approved bulk-tonnage underground silver-gold mine in Jalisco, Mexico. With permits secured (June 8, 2026), a positive construction decision from the board, and cash in hand that fully funds the build without dilution or debt, GoGold's path from junior silver producer to Mexico's next primary silver underground mine is capital-financed and permit-cleared — the remaining variable is the 24-month construction timeline.

headline: SILVER UP 70% YEAR-OVER-YEAR AT $65.58 — Structural Demand From Solar, EVs and Data Centers Reshapes Precious Metals Hierarchy
snippet: COMEX silver was quoted at $65.58 per ounce on August 13, 2026, representing a 70.2% year-over-year gain that materially outpaces gold's own impressive performance — a divergence driven by silver's dual role as both a monetary metal benefiting from Federal Reserve rate-pause expectations and an industrial metal whose consumption is accelerating across photovoltaic solar panel manufacturing, EV battery systems, and AI data centre infrastructure. The metal has also maintained a structural supply deficit for six consecutive years, with annual consumption consistently exceeding global mine production. For junior silver mining investors, 70% YoY price appreciation fundamentally reprices the NPV and IRR of projects that were evaluated at $25–$35/oz silver, the prior planning range that most TSX-V silver explorer feasibility studies and resource estimates were modelled against — those economics are now materially stale on the high side.

headline: P2 GOLD DRILLS 79.25m @ 0.78 g/t Au + 0.29% Cu AT LUCKY STRIKE — Nevada Gold-Copper Advances to Q4 2026 Feasibility Study
source_name: Rohstoff Welt / P2 Gold Inc. (TSX-V: PGLD)
snippet: P2 Gold Inc. (TSX-V: PGLD) released August 12 infill and expansion drill results from the Lucky Strike Zone at its Gabbs gold-copper project on the Walker Lane Trend in Nevada, with the best intercept returning 79.25 metres at 0.78 g/t gold and 0.29% copper — including a 21.34-metre high-grade core at 1.28 g/t gold and 0.34% copper — confirming the thickening and southwestward extension of the high-grade gold-copper core at depth. The Gabbs Project's 2023 PEA outlines a long-life, mid-size Nevada mine producing an average of 109,000 ounces gold and 33 million pounds copper annually over a 14.2-year mine life; an updated Mineral Resource Estimate is in progress for Q3 2026, forming the basis of a feasibility study expected in Q4 2026. At Walker Lane gold-copper projects, sequential MRE → feasibility delivery in a single calendar year is one of the most reliable re-rating catalysts in the junior space.

headline: KINROSS DRILLS RILEY GOLD'S VIRGIN CORTEZ NEVADA TARGETS — $20M Earn-In Unlocks Never-Drilled 27.2 km² in Battle Mountain-Eureka Trend
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Riley Gold Corp. (TSX-V: RLYG)
snippet: Riley Gold Corp. (TSX-V: RLYG) announced August 12 that Kinross Gold has commenced the 2026 drill program at the Pipeline West/Clipper (PWC) gold project in Nevada's Cortez District — the same structural corridor hosting major producing mines — under Kinross's 2024 earn-in agreement allowing it to acquire up to 75% of PWC by spending USD$20 million. Kinross's technical team has identified high-priority, never-drilled targets along the highest-grade gold-in-soils anomaly area across the 27.2 square kilometre land package. For junior mining investors, the Kinross earn-in structure is a textbook value de-risking mechanism: a senior gold producer is deploying its own technical and financial capital to drill targets it has independently assessed as high-priority, reducing Riley Gold's exploration risk while simultaneously validating the district-scale geological thesis that motivated Kinross's participation.

headline: BOMBORÉ STRIKE KEEPS GROWING: Orezone Drills New Zones on 14km System — Q1 2027 MRE Update to Reshape Resource Base
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Orezone Gold Corporation (TSX: ORE; ASX: ORE)
snippet: Orezone Gold Corporation (TSX/ASX: ORE) announced August 11 positive step-out drill results from its Bomboré Gold Mine in Burkina Faso demonstrating growth potential along multiple zones within the 14-kilometre-long reserve-defined gold system, with results expected to support a Mineral Resource and Reserve Update planned for Q1 2027. The significance for investors lies in the scale differential: Bomboré's existing reserve base is among the largest in West Africa, and systematic step-out drilling confirming along-strike extensions at gold above $4,400/oz creates material optionality for open-pit expansion beyond the current mine plan in a jurisdiction where the operating mine already provides physical security and infrastructure overhead to adjacent resource growth.

headline: KENO HILL SILVER DISTRICT AWAKENS: Silver North SNAG Advances 10-Hole Haldane Program, Launches Veronica Field Season
source_name: Investing News Network / Silver North Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: SNAG)
snippet: Silver North Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: SNAG) announced August 13 that diamond drilling is continuing at its Haldane Silver Property in Yukon's Keno Hill Silver District — the historic camp that produced over 200 million ounces of silver from high-grade narrow veins at grades exceeding 100 oz/t Ag — with 10 holes completed to date in the 2026 program. The company also commenced the 2026 field season at its Veronica Property in the Silvertip District of southeastern Yukon. At silver up 70% year-over-year, the economics of exploration-stage projects in Keno Hill are being re-evaluated against price assumptions that are dramatically higher than the $25–$35/oz models built into predecessor company valuations; a historic 200 million-ounce district with active drilling at current silver prices represents exactly the type of optionality that re-rates when commodity price structure shifts structurally rather than cyclically.

headline: CAN PPI TRIGGER $4,500 GOLD? — Analysis: Soft Inflation Data + Fed Pause = Mathematical Path to New Records This Month
snippet: Invezz analysis published August 13 examines the specific mathematical path from gold's current position near two-month highs to the $4,500 breakout level that technical analysts have identified as the next major resistance, arguing that a flat or negative PPI print — combined with the Federal Reserve's documented hesitancy on further rate hikes after July CPI printed at 3.4% — removes the last fundamental argument for dollar strength that could constrain gold's upside. The analysis notes that every $50 move in gold from $4,400 to $4,500 translates to a proportionally larger leverage move in gold mining equities — the sector's operating leverage means miner earnings grow at 2-3x the rate of the gold price above AISC — making the $4,500 target not just a spot price milestone but a potential earnings-multiple re-rating catalyst for producers whose Q3 results would reflect sustained operation at those price levels.

headline: 1,801m DRILLED AT HIGHLAND VALLEY COPPER CAMP: GSP Resource Expands Alwin-Mer Phase 1, Assays Expected Q3 2026
source_name: Junior Mining Network / GSP Resource Corp. (TSX-V: GSPR)
snippet: GSP Resource Corp. (TSX-V: GSPR) completed an expanded 2026 Phase 1 diamond drill program at its Alwin Mine and Mer properties in the Highland Valley Copper Camp of BC — the same district hosting Teck Resources' Highland Valley Copper mine, Canada's largest open-pit copper mine — drilling 1,801 metres across eight holes, exceeding its planned 1,200–1,500m range after visual indicators of alteration and mineralisation prompted hole extensions. At Alwin, four step-out holes extended the 2024 high-grade gold discovery; the Mer target received its first-ever modern drill test, targeting a porphyry copper system. All core is logged and sampled, with assays submitted to ALS Canada in Kamloops and results expected in stages through Q3 2026. For copper investors: proximity to the Highland Valley mine infrastructure and Teck's proven porphyry geology across the camp provides the district-scale geological validation that makes first-drill results at adjacent junior targets among the most watched early-stage catalysts in BC copper exploration.
